text: In the 2022 public offer for Accell Group, the offeror Sprint BidCo B.V. — an affiliate of investment funds advised by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. LP (KKR) — acquired 96.90% of Accell Group's shares; the Offeror, KKR and Teslin (via Teslin Alpine Acquisition B.V.) are together referred to as the Consortium.

source.name: Joint press release by Accell Group N.V. and Sprint BidCo B.V.: Final results of the Offer for Accell Group: 96.90% obtained
source.quote: The Offeror is an affiliate of the affiliated investment funds advised by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. LP
